results.content: Recent polling data, however, suggests challenges for the GOP. A national Economist/YouGov poll released on August 4 shows Democrats leading Republicans by 8 points on the generic ballot. Additionally, Trump's approval rating has fallen to 36%, with 60% disapproving of his performance as president.

Among registered voters, Democrats led the generic congressional ballot 42 percent to 37 percent. Independents favored Democratic candidates by 12 points.

Reuters/Ipsos surveyed 4,505 U.S. adults nationwide online July 30-August 3. The poll had a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

## Competitive Districts Show Similar Pattern

New analysis from Economist/YouGov suggested Democratic strength extends beyond heavily blue districts.
results.title: Donald Trump Gets Worrying Midterm Warning Sign Across 3 New Polls

results.content:
## ‘Fake’ polls

Trump’s visit to Las Vegas comes as polls show his job approval rating sliding, including a survey released Tuesday that brought more bad news for the president and congressional GOP candidates.

Democrats enjoyed an 8-point lead on the generic congressional ballot, according to a July 31-Aug. 3 YouGov-The Economist survey, with 41 percent of U.S. adults saying they supported the Democratic candidate for Congress, while 33 percent opted for the Republican.
